entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers: a married father whose children include his one-year-old son Kyle and his daughter Sara. He grew up in West County, worked for a mechanical engineering company where he was promoted to assistant manager in mid-June 2023 and lost his job in early August 2023 when it collapsed, and repeatedly runs for local office on education and infrastructure. He does kickboxing, beginner yoga, camping, hiking and family boot camps, failed a military aptitude test in late 2022 and retook it with good results in March 2023, and joined a fire-fighting brigade in July 2023 which by 16 August 2023 he called his true calling.

entities.name: Maria
entities.description: The other speaker and John's close friend. She has volunteered at a homeless shelter since about August 2022, joined a nearby church on 5 May 2023 and a gym in June 2023, practises aerial yoga and by June 2023 kundalini yoga, took a solo trip to Spain in 2022 and a trip to London a few years before 2023, and acquired two dogs, Coco and Shadow, in August 2023. Her family is small and she was inspired to volunteer by an aunt who helped her family through money problems.

entities.name: Kyle
entities.description: John's youngest child, a one-year-old son as of 6 March 2023.

entities.name: Sara
entities.description: John's daughter; his family took a trip in 2022 for her birthday, photographed on a railway track in the autumn.

entities.name: Rob
entities.description: A colleague of John's who invited him to a beginner's yoga class, which John mentioned on 25 February 2023.

entities.name: Jean
entities.description: A woman Maria met while volunteering on 24 February 2023. She had been through a divorce, lost her job and become homeless, yet stayed optimistic, valued the little things and believed in kindness; Maria said she showed her the importance of gratitude and connection.

entities.name: David
entities.description: A man Maria met at a charity event on 3 February 2023 whose story of hardship humbled her; she afterwards connected him with a nearby organisation offering housing and support for homeless people.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: An elderly veteran John met while visiting a veterans' hospital in the week before 17 July 2023, whose stories John found both inspiring and heartbreaking.

entities.name: Laura
entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter who wrote Maria and the other volunteers a letter expressing her gratitude, which Maria described on 3 July 2023.

entities.name: Cindy
entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter who wrote a note of heartfelt gratitude about the support the residents receive, which Maria described on 3 August 2023.

entities.name: Maria's aunt
entities.description: Maria's aunt, who believed in volunteering and helped Maria's family when they had money problems in Maria's youth. She is the reason Maria started volunteering.

entities.name: Maria's cousin
entities.description: A cousin of Maria's who had to leave her home in a hurry in mid-2023. Maria was helping her find a new place as of 3 July 2023 and John offered to look for organisations that could help her.

entities.name: John's family

properties.aliases: my family; my fam; the wife and kids; the missus and the kids; my kids

entities.description: John's household treated as one group: his wife and their children, among them his son Kyle and his daughter Sara. They took a road trip through the Pacific Northwest in 2022, holidayed in California, go to the park near their home several times a week, make pizza and share meals together, kept the dog Max for ten years until mid-2023, and from April 2023 did boot camp workouts together three times a week. John calls them his rock and his motivation throughout the conversation.

entities.name: Maria's family

properties.aliases: my fam; my family; my siblings

entities.description: Maria's family, which she describes as small. It includes her mother, with whom she cooked dinner on 3 May 2023, her siblings, and her grandmother, who died in the week before 6 March 2023. They had money problems when Maria was young and were helped by her aunt, took a road trip to Oregon when she was younger, and holidayed in Florida.

entities.name: John's workmates

properties.aliases: my colleagues; my workmates; my buddies; my team

entities.description: The colleagues John works with, treated as one group. They went to a convention about using technology for good in March 2023, on a hiking trip photographed by 25 May 2023, and on a mountaineering trip in the week before 12 June 2023 on which they reached the summit.

entities.name: Maria's church friends

properties.aliases: friends from church; my church friends

entities.description: The friends Maria made after joining her church on 5 May 2023, treated as one group. They camped together over 10-11 June 2023, picnicked with games on the weekend of 15-16 July 2023, hiked that same weekend, and did community work with her on 4 August 2023.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: John's family dog of ten years, who died shortly before 3 June 2023. John said Max taught the family unconditional love and loyalty and wanted his children to learn the same; his best memory of Max is a camping trip in the summer of 2022 on which they hiked and swam. John said on 11 August 2023 that he still thinks about him.

entities.name: Coco
entities.description: Maria's first dog, a puppy she got about two weeks before 11 August 2023. She greets Maria when she comes home; caring for her was an adjustment Maria called worth it. She gets on well with Shadow.

entities.name: Shadow
entities.description: Maria's second dog, a puppy adopted from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023. She is full of energy, was learning commands and house training by mid-August 2023, and gets on well with Coco.

entities.name: The homeless shelter Maria volunteers at
entities.description: The homeless shelter Maria has volunteered at since about a year before 3 August 2023, which she approached after seeing a family struggling on the streets. Maria donated her old car to it on 21 December 2022, ran meals, talks and a children's event there, met Jean, Laura and Cindy through it, ran a 5K charity run for it over the weekend of 1-2 April 2023, organised a late-May 2023 fundraiser with a chili cook-off and ring-toss tournament, and was given a medal by it in the week before 9 August 2023. She calls the people there like family.

entities.name: Maria's church
entities.description: The nearby church Maria joined on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to a community and to her faith. She found it great, and the friends she made there camp, picnic, hike and do community work with her.

entities.name: John's fire-fighting brigade

properties.aliases: the fire brigade; the local fire station

entities.description: The fire-fighting brigade John joined shortly before 31 July 2023 after Maria's shelter work made him think about giving back. Training was intense and taxing; its first call-out with him was on Sunday 30 July 2023, when the team saved a family from a burning building. It ran a two-hour donation drive before 16 August 2023 collecting canned food, toiletries and clothes, and those donations helped pay for a new fire truck. John says the team have become like family and that the work is his true calling.

entities.name: The local dog shelter

properties.aliases: a local dog shelter; a shelter

entities.description: A local dog shelter where Maria started volunteering once a month shortly before 3 June 2023. Maria adopted the puppy Shadow from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023.

entities.name: Maria's gym
entities.description: The gym Maria joined in the week before 16 June 2023. She found the atmosphere welcoming and the people good, stuck to her workout routine there, and had dinner with friends from it on 7 July 2023.

entities.name: John's yoga studio
entities.description: The yoga studio John attends often, which he described on 22 July 2023 as having a chill atmosphere and good instructors. It offers yoga, kickboxing and circuit training; John had also done weight training there, which he found challenging but peaceful.

entities.name: John's service-focused online group

properties.aliases: a service-focused online group; the virtual support group

entities.description: The service-focused online group John joined in the week before 1 January 2023 and still belonged to in August 2023. Its members met at events, gave out food and supplies at a homeless shelter and ran a toy drive for children in need, and were planning projects giving underserved communities access to education, mentorship, job training and resume building. On 3 August 2023 John asked his family and friends to join it and become advocates for the military.

entities.name: The mechanical engineering company John worked for
entities.description: John's employer until August 2023. He was promoted to assistant manager there between 12 and 16 June 2023 after a long wait, kept a trophy commemorating the obstacles he overcame, and said on 22 July 2023 that he was enjoying the role and that his team were encouraging. The company collapsed and John lost his job between 31 July and 5 August 2023.

entities.name: The local school John volunteers at
entities.description: A local school in John's community. He volunteered at its career fair over the weekend of 1-2 April 2023, where he saw how a lack of resources limits the pupils' dreams, and by 13 August 2023 he was volunteering there as a mentor, with the students visibly improving in confidence and skills. The two mentions are joined here because both are 'a local school' in John's own community and nothing in the conversation separates them.

entities.name: West County

properties.aliases: my old area; back home; my hometown

entities.description: The area John grew up in and used to live in, and which he says he wants to help improve. He helped renovate a rundown community centre there in 2022, and it was hit by a bad flood in the week before 7 July 2023 that ruined many homes because its infrastructure was poor.

entities.name: The Pacific Northwest
entities.description: The coastal region John and his family explored on their 2022 family road trip, visiting several national parks; John described the natural beauty as breathtaking.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city Maria visited on a trip to England a few years before 2023. Its architecture captivated her and inspired the castle shadow box and the castle painting she made for her home as reminders of London's history and grace.

entities.name: England
entities.description: The country Maria travelled to a few years before 2023, where she was mesmerised by the castles and visited London.

entities.name: Spain
entities.description: Where Maria took a solo trip in 2022, photographing a beach and a small island. The trip taught her to rely on her inner strength, to value different perspectives and solitude, and it was where she tried surfing for the first time.

entities.name: Oregon
entities.description: Where Maria's family went on a road trip when she was younger. Its prettiest spot was a waterfall with a bridge over it that she hiked to, which she said felt like a fairy tale.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where John and his family took a vacation he remembers for a gorgeous sunset and an evening stroll along the shore.

entities.name: Florida
entities.description: Where Maria and her family took a vacation; she remembers the colours of the sunset and a feeling of gratitude sitting with them.

entities.name: The East Coast
entities.description: The destination of a trip John said on 18 April 2023 that he was planning; the conversation never returns to whether he took it.

entities.name: The park near John's home
entities.description: The park with a playground that John and his family visit a few times a week, where they climb, slide, play games and picnic. It is the setting of several family photos John shared between December 2022 and August 2023.

entities.name: John's car
entities.description: John's car. Its windshield was broken in an unexpected roadside incident in the week before 9 January 2023, and it broke down on his way to work on Friday 7 April 2023, with the repairs straining his finances. John also says the pothole-ridden local roads are damaging to cars.

entities.name: John's run for local office
entities.description: John's repeated attempts to enter local politics, campaigning on improving education and infrastructure. Referred to as 'the campaign', 'running for office' and 'my political goals'. From hoping to get into local politics in December 2022, through networking with local leaders and attending a community meeting in January 2023, he told Maria on 25 February 2023 that he was running for office again, and said on 6 May 2023 that he had decided the previous week to run again despite not having been successful before. All mentions of running for office are joined here because nothing in the conversation separates them into distinct campaigns.

entities.name: John's politics blog
entities.description: The blog about politics and government John had been writing by 18 April 2023. He researches policies, particularly education reform and infrastructure development, and publishes his thoughts to raise awareness and start conversations; he had received good feedback on the posts.

entities.name: John's community food drive
entities.description: The community food drive John started helping with shortly before 5 February 2023 for people who had lost their jobs, prompted by unemployment in his neighbourhood. It drew an overwhelming response and many volunteers, and Maria offered to help with networking and at future events.

entities.name: John's veterans support project
entities.description: The project John was running by 20 May 2023 to support military veterans, centred on a petition he was trying to get going. He found it rewarding but stressful; it included a small party on Friday 19 May 2023 at which veterans shared stories and found camaraderie, and it put him back in touch with friends. Maria offered to help with it.

entities.name: The homeless shelter's fundraiser
entities.description: The fundraiser Maria organised for the homeless shelter in late May 2023, including a ring-toss tournament she was planning and a chili cook-off, intended to raise enough to cover basic needs for homeless people. John agreed to spread the word using its poster and to find people willing to volunteer at it.

entities.name: Kickboxing
entities.description: The martial art John was doing as of 17 December 2022, which he said was giving him a lot of energy; the yoga studio he attends also offers kickboxing classes.

entities.name: Aerial yoga
entities.description: The form of yoga Maria had just started as of 17 December 2022 and still practised in June 2023. She uses it to switch off and focus on her body, and her favourites are the upside-down poses, which make her feel free and light.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: Yoga as the two speakers practise it. John's colleague Rob invited him to a beginner's class in February 2023; he started a weekend beginner class with a colleague shortly before 7 April 2023, focused on poses and breathing, and made it part of his daily routine, attending a yoga studio often. Maria was trying kundalini yoga by 16 June 2023. Maria's aerial yoga is recorded as a separate activity.

entities.name: Camping
entities.description: Camping, which John has done plenty of times and calls an uncomplicated way to be at one with nature, including a trip with his dog Max in the summer of 2022, and which Maria has done a few times, including with her church friends over 10-11 June 2023.

entities.name: Hiking
entities.description: Hiking, which Maria does with friends and with her church friends and did as a child to reach a waterfall in Oregon, and which John does with his family and with his workmates.

entities.name: Family boot camp workouts
entities.description: The boot camp workouts John started doing with his family in April 2023, three times a week, for bonding and fitness. The family gained energy, strength and endurance, supported each other through the sessions, and his children became keen on staying active.
